newsitem.title: UK: Chase tops interest rate swaps survey - Risk.
newsitem.headline: Chase tops interest rate swaps survey - Risk.

text.p: Chase Manhattan Bank is the leading interest rate swaps house, according to a Risk Magazine survey of banks, brokers and other derivatives dealers.

Risk, a British-based publication covering the derivatives market, based its ranking on responses made in June and July by over 100 institutions from around the world. SBC Warburg was ranked top currency options player, while J.P. Morgan was voted top interest rate options house.
SBC Warburg also topped the equity derivatives table.
